slides.subtitle: Loader, printer, 180,000 CPH LED placer, 20-zone reflow, cooling buffer, AOI and unloader in one left-to-right line, sized for 300 good strips an hour.
slides.notes: Southern Machinery technical quotation for an LED T8 SMT line, 22-Oct-2026 (customer, prices and commercial terms removed). Concept view: engineering targets pending FAT.

slides.title: From bare strip to inspected LED board

steps.b: Strips are loaded by hand into carriers. SM-VL1200 vacuum loader feeds the SM-1200 stencil printer with 2D inspection. SM-PM500 mixes paste off-line.
SM-F7S places SMD2835 LEDs with 34 heads and 68 feeder stations, group picking and group placement.
SM-R733 reflow with 10 top / 10 bottom heating zones and 3 cooling zones, then the SM-CVB1200 vertical buffer cools carriers before AOI.
SM-AI1251 AOI checks polarity, missing or shifted LEDs and visible solder defects; SM-UL1200 unloads; carriers return to loading.

slides.title: 300 good strips an hour on two shifts

metrics.l: good strips / h for 100,000 a month

slides.text: At 300 good 120-LED strips an hour the line needs 36,000 net LED placements an hour, 48,000 ideal at 75 % effectiveness. Bottleneck cycle: ≤108 s with 12 strips per carrier, ≤144 s with 16. A single 8-hour shift would need 480.8 good strips an hour for 100,000 a month. 3–4 operators per shift; changeover 30–60 min.
slides.notes: Concept view: engineering targets pending FAT on the approved product and carriers.

slides.title: Built around 1,170 mm LED strips
bullets: Rigid FR4 and aluminium MCPCB strips, 8 mm and 10 mm wide, 1,150 mm nominal and 1,170 mm required.
96 and 120 SMD2835 LEDs per strip; two recipes, four stencil patterns.
Carrier envelope target ≤1,200 × 250 mm: only 30 mm remains for end features and tolerances.
12–16 strips per carrier; 40 carriers to start, provisionally 20 for each width.
Bare 8/10 mm strips cannot be fed directly: carriers hold them through every station.
If a safe carrier is longer than 1,200 mm, the 1,200 mm stations must be revised.

slides.title: Seven stages from design review to hand-over

steps.b: Approved product data, carriers and full-length station interfaces.
Loaded-carrier dry run, sensor, SMEMA and interlock checks, safe stops.
Real print and placement run for both 96- and 120-LED recipes.
Loaded FR4 and MCPCB thermal profiles within paste and LED limits.
Known-good and seeded-defect samples; agreed false-call and escape limits.
One full 8-hour shift on the bottleneck product, logging good output, rejects and stops; target 300 good strips an hour.
Functional, thermal and sample checks on site; operator and maintenance training.

slides.title: What is still to be confirmed
bullets: Items marked provisional (placer configuration, unloader, feeders, nozzles, carriers, stencils, profiler, FCT) need sample-run approval.
Loader pickup on loaded carriers, stack weight and double-pick prevention need joint approval.
96/120-LED cycle time on the placer is a FAT item; published 180,000 CPH is not line output.
Reflow zone revision, cooling count, exhaust flow and full-load profiles to be confirmed.
AOI false calls, escapes and full-carrier cycle time are acceptance items; no 3D claim is made.
Optional FCT checks continuity, polarity and light-up only, not CCT or CRI.
